mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_case_review (project_id, status, report_markdown, create_by, create_time) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{status}, #{reportMarkdown}, #{createBy}, #{createTime})
INSERT INTO sys_case_review_item (review_id, case_id, verdict, item_comment) VALUES (#{reviewId}, #{caseId}, #{verdict}, #{comment})
mapper.select: SELECT review_id AS reviewId, project_id AS projectId, status, report_markdown AS reportMarkdown, create_by AS createBy, create_time AS createTime, complete_by AS completeBy, complete_time AS completeTime FROM sys_case_review WHERE project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY review_id DESC

SELECT i.item_id AS itemId, i.review_id AS reviewId, i.case_id AS caseId, i.verdict, i.item_comment AS comment, c.case_num AS caseNum, c.case_name AS caseName, t.type_name AS caseTypeName FROM sys_case_review_item i LEFT JOIN sys_case c ON c.case_id = i.case_id LEFT JOIN sys_case_type t ON t.type_id = c.case_type WHERE i.review_id = #{reviewId} ORDER BY i.item_id
